If 2 is a cubic non-residue then the k=1 and k=2 coefficients correspond to two distinct periods; the zero-sum and square-sum identities force one to have size at least a fixed multiple of sqrt(p). Chebotarev in Q(zeta_12,cuberoot(2)) supplies infinitely many such primes.
